brief.en: Map a current problem, the obstacles and a desired outcome as a bridge. Label the actions that connect both sides.
brief.zh: 用桥梁结构连接当前问题与目标，标出障碍及跨越它们的具体行动。

title.en: A product cycle, drawn as a loop

brief.en: Explain a product development cycle from research to launch and feedback, with an unambiguous reading direction.
brief.zh: 按研究、设计、验证、发布、反馈组织产品周期，并让阅读方向清晰。

title.zh: 把两个方案摆在一起比较

brief.en: Compare two proposals against the same six criteria. Separate supplied facts from undecided trade-offs.
brief.zh: 用相同的六项标准比较两个方案，区分已知事实和待决定的取舍。

title.en: Find the roots of a problem
title.zh: 用鱼骨图追溯问题根因

brief.en: Organize possible causes under people, process, tools and environment. Distinguish hypotheses from verified causes.
brief.zh: 按人员、流程、工具和环境整理可能原因，区分假设与已验证根因。

title.zh: 看清转化漏斗的每一层

brief.en: Visualize awareness, interest, consideration, decision and retention with supplied counts and explicit conversion denominators.
brief.zh: 呈现认知、兴趣、考虑、决策和留存各阶段，使用提供的人数并明确转化率分母。

title.zh: 用冰山讲清看不见的投入

brief.en: Separate visible outcomes from supporting work, constraints and learning below the surface.
brief.zh: 区分水面上的成果与水面下的投入、约束和学习过程。

brief.en: Map customer touchpoints from discovery to advocacy, pairing each stage with a question and an opportunity.
brief.zh: 从发现到主动推荐绘制用户触点，为每个阶段配一个问题与改进机会。

title.zh: 把技术栈一层层讲清楚

brief.en: Explain an application stack from infrastructure to interface, showing responsibilities and dependencies rather than decorative jargon.
brief.zh: 从基础设施到用户界面分层解释系统，标明职责与依赖，不堆砌术语。

title.en: Give an idea room to branch

brief.en: Organize a central concept into distinct branches, subtopics and useful cross-links without repeating the same idea.
brief.zh: 围绕核心概念展开不同分支、子主题和关联，避免重复节点。

brief.en: Place tasks on an urgency-versus-importance matrix and label do, schedule, delegate and drop decisions.
brief.zh: 按紧急程度与重要性整理任务，标明立即处理、安排、委派和放弃。

title.zh: 把发展历程排成时间线

brief.en: Turn dated milestones into a horizontal timeline. Preserve actual dates and keep unsupported achievements out.
brief.zh: 把有日期的里程碑整理成横向时间线，保留真实日期，不编造成就。

title.en: An organization that is easy to read

brief.en: Draw an organization tree with supplied roles and reporting lines. Keep one level per visual tier.
brief.zh: 根据提供的岗位与汇报关系绘制组织树，让每层视觉结构对应一个层级。

brief.en: Storyboard an original journey in three wide cinematic panels, maintaining the protagonist and geography between shots.
brief.zh: 把原创旅程画成三个宽银幕分镜，保持主角造型和空间关系连续。

title.en: Explain an engine with sequential art

brief.en: Use a dense educational comic to explain a supplied mechanism. Have a domain expert check labels and causal steps before educational use.
brief.zh: 用信息密集的科普漫画解释提供的原理；教学使用前请专业人士核对标注与因果步骤。

brief.en: Create a vertical reading tutorial with clear panel rhythm, brief dialogue and consistent original characters.
brief.zh: 制作适合竖向阅读的教程条漫，分镜节奏清晰，对话简短，原创角色保持一致。

brief.en: Create a technology article cover with one forceful headline, geometric color bands and a quiet subtitle area.
brief.zh: 为科技文章制作封面，用一个醒目的标题、几何色带和克制的副标题区域构图。

brief.en: Create a sustainable-living article cover using flowing landscape contours, organic texture and readable typography.
brief.zh: 用流动地形线、有机纹理和清晰文字制作可持续生活文章封面。

brief.en: Illustrate an original reflective article cover with watercolor scenery and a restrained title, avoiding medical promises.
brief.zh: 用水彩景致与克制标题绘制反思主题文章封面，不使用医疗功效承诺。

brief.en: Illustrate a supplied system architecture with clean connections, readable component names and a blueprint visual language.
brief.zh: 按提供的系统结构绘制蓝图风格配图，组件名称易读，连接关系清楚。

brief.en: Illustrate idea generation with original flat doodles, notes and arrows. Keep visual hierarchy around one central idea.
brief.zh: 用原创扁平涂鸦、便签和箭头表现创意过程，围绕一个中心建立层级。

title.en: An article with an arcade spirit
title.zh: 给游戏文章一点像素趣味

brief.en: Create an original pixel-art illustration for a gaming-and-technology article, using generic devices and no copied game characters.
brief.zh: 为游戏科技文章绘制原创像素配图，使用通用设备，不复制游戏角色。

brief.en: Create an original botanical illustration with balanced flower clusters and quiet space for adjacent editorial text.
brief.zh: 用平衡的花卉组合制作原创植物水彩配图，为相邻正文留出视觉空间。

title.en: Four ideas on one learning card
title.zh: 一张卡片讲清四个学习要点

brief.en: Turn four supplied learning ideas into a mobile-friendly card with a balanced two-by-two layout.
brief.zh: 把四个学习要点整理成适合手机阅读的四宫格卡片。

title.zh: 把知识压缩成可读的速查卡

brief.en: Organize a supplied knowledge summary into compact sections, keeping body text readable at phone width.
brief.zh: 把知识总结组织成紧凑分区，同时确保手机宽度下正文可读。

title.zh: 一张值得收藏的清单卡

brief.en: Present five supplied recommendations with explicit selection criteria. Label sample products rather than inventing endorsements.
brief.zh: 按明确标准展示五项建议，示例产品需标注，不伪造推荐背书。

title.zh: 把日常流程拆成步骤卡

brief.en: Turn a supplied routine into four ordered steps with one action per step. Use the preview for layout, not as health advice.
brief.zh: 把提供的日常流程拆成四步，每步一个动作；参考示例版式，不将其当作健康建议。

brief.en: Design a results slide using supplied revenue, user and satisfaction metrics, with units and reporting dates.
brief.zh: 根据提供的收入、用户和满意度数据制作结果页，注明单位与统计日期。

title.zh: 用一页解释机器学习流程

brief.en: Explain data, training and predictions in three visual stages, separating simplified diagrams from technical specifications.
brief.zh: 用数据、训练和预测三个视觉阶段解释流程，区分简化示意与技术规格。

title.en: A science lesson with visual structure
title.zh: 有视觉结构的科学课程页

brief.en: Turn expert-checked science notes into a clearly labeled teaching slide. Verify every scientific annotation before use.
brief.zh: 把经专业核对的科学笔记转成标注清晰的教学页，使用前逐一核查科学文字。

title.en: Welcome to an illustrated AI city
title.zh: 走进插画里的 AI 城市

brief.en: Create a slide introducing a fictional AI city with an original vector scene and one readable headline.
brief.zh: 以原创矢量城市场景与一个清晰标题，制作虚构 AI 城市的介绍页。

brief.en: A developer roadmap with pixel typography, resource charts and milestone views.
brief.zh: 用像素标题、资源图表和里程碑展示开发路线。

brief.en: An arts programme combining a large serif cover, attendance chart and generous editorial spacing.
brief.zh: 用大衬线封面、观众数据和留白组织艺术活动企划。

brief.en: A playful business update with framed panels, grouped bars and an impact summary.
brief.zh: 用趣味边框、分组柱状图和成果摘要讲述业务进展。

brief.en: An annual-review deck with assertive red-and-black type, financial tiles and strategic priorities.
brief.zh: 以红黑大字、财务信息格和战略重点组织年度回顾。

title.en: A hierarchy that makes a point

brief.en: A strong typographic presentation with a stepped pyramid linking operations, product and mission.
brief.zh: 用强烈文字和阶梯金字塔连接运营、产品与使命。

brief.en: A system presentation using pill-shaped labels, a performance chart and an architecture flow.
brief.zh: 用胶囊标签、表现图表和架构流程说明系统。

brief.en: A minimal strategy deck that moves from quarterly comparisons to implementation phases.
brief.zh: 用极简版式从季度对比过渡到实施阶段。

brief.en: A field report with a six-part index, chart-led evidence and disciplined blue grid typography.
brief.zh: 用六部分索引、图表证据和规整的钴蓝网格文字构建报告。

brief.en: A creative-process deck with layered architecture and a four-stage discover-to-deliver sequence.
brief.zh: 通过分层架构与探索到交付的四步结构解释创作流程。

brief.en: A cheerful team-introduction deck with a daily schedule and a friendly team roster.
brief.zh: 以轻快的日程页和成员介绍组织团队欢迎会。

brief.en: A studio brief combining eight principles, a headline metric and warm tri-tone editorial layouts.
brief.zh: 将八项原则、关键指标与暖色三色版式组合成工作室简报。

brief.en: A high-contrast proposal moving from positioning to a clear before-and-after value argument.
brief.zh: 从定位到前后价值对比，用高对比版式组织提案。

title.en: An invitation to the long table

brief.en: A community programme with past editions, a forthcoming event schedule and warm newsletter-like typography.
brief.zh: 用往期活动、后续日程和温暖的通讯式排版介绍社群计划。

title.en: A quarterly review in forest green

brief.en: A quarterly review with a structured agenda and comparative revenue chart on an editorial canvas.
brief.zh: 用分区议程与收入对比图表组织编辑式季度回顾。

brief.en: A financial-product pitch with oversized adoption figures, grid-based evidence and staged next steps.
brief.zh: 用大号采用数据、网格证据和分阶段行动说明金融产品。

brief.en: A workshop summary using note cards, three agreed principles and three concrete next bets.
brief.zh: 用便签、三项共识原则和三个后续行动总结工作坊。

brief.en: A fashion-editorial presentation with dramatic chapter openings, serif type and carefully spaced quotations.
brief.zh: 用戏剧感章节页、衬线字和留白引文组织时尚编辑稿。

title.zh: 复古桌面里的业务复盘

brief.en: A business-review template that uses desktop-window metaphors for revenue and organization views.
brief.zh: 以桌面窗口隐喻展示收入和组织结构的业务复盘模板。

brief.en: A venture-studio introduction with a compact facts panel and tactile card-based capability sections.
brief.zh: 用紧凑资料面板和纸卡式能力分区介绍创业工作室。

title.zh: 磁带包装风的产品目录

brief.en: A product catalogue using diagonal color ribbons, compact specification columns and a bold statement page.
brief.zh: 用斜向色带、紧凑规格栏和宣言页组织产品目录。

brief.en: A workshop presentation with sticky-note groupings, growth charts and a distribution overview.
brief.zh: 用便签分组、增长图表和分布概览组织工作坊演示。

brief.en: A research summary combining insight cards, headline figures and retention curves.
brief.zh: 通过洞察卡、关键数字与留存曲线总结研究。

brief.en: A partnership deck pairing four design principles with a side-by-side pilot comparison table.
brief.zh: 用四项设计原则和并列试点对比表组织合作提案。

title.zh: 并行 Agent 技术封面

brief.en: Create a cover for a technical article on parallel agents, using strong hierarchy and one accent color.
brief.zh: 为并行 Agent 技术文章制作封面，使用明确的文字层级和一种点缀色。

title.zh: 有证据结构的技术简报

brief.en: Turn supplied technical findings into a tall briefing with sections, comparisons and explicit data sources.
brief.zh: 把技术发现组织成纵向简报，包含分区、比较及明确的数据来源。

brief.en: Design a benchmark summary with supplied scores, methodology and date. Do not reuse the sample numbers as current findings.
brief.zh: 根据提供的分数、方法和日期制作基准测试摘要，不把示例数字当作当前结论。

brief.en: Design a tool directory with search, categories, concise summaries and transparent submission criteria.
brief.zh: 设计带搜索、分类、简要说明及透明提交标准的工具导航。

brief.en: Build a writing-product landing prototype with a document preview, feature explanation and a clear starting action.
brief.zh: 制作写作产品落地页原型，包含文稿预览、功能说明和清晰入口。

brief.en: Create a developer-docs prototype with persistent navigation, endpoint examples and readable code blocks.
brief.zh: 制作开发者文档原型，包含固定导航、接口示例和易读代码块。

brief.en: Design a maker portfolio around selected projects and a clear introduction. Use real supplied achievements, never the example metrics.
brief.zh: 围绕精选项目和清晰介绍设计创作者主页，使用真实资料，不复制示例成就数字。

brief.en: Create an analytics landing prototype with a sample dashboard, product explanation and a focused trial invitation.
brief.zh: 制作数据分析产品落地页原型，包含示例仪表盘、产品说明和明确试用入口。

title.zh: 瑞士字体感的演示文稿

brief.en: Create a presentation using disciplined grids, oversized typography and a clear reading order.
brief.zh: 用严谨网格、大号字体和清晰阅读顺序制作演示文稿。

brief.en: Create an editorial guide with a cover, writing principles and concise worked examples.
brief.zh: 制作编辑式指南，包含封面、写作原则和简明示例。

title.en: An editorial document on warm paper

brief.en: Lay out a multi-section document with readable serif headings, a calm column structure and useful summaries.
brief.zh: 用易读衬线标题、克制的分栏和实用摘要排版多章节文档。

title.en: A product email with a point
title.zh: 重点清晰的产品营销邮件

brief.en: Design a product-launch email with a single offer, supplied product details and a clear call to action.
brief.zh: 围绕一个主张、提供的产品信息和明确行动入口设计发布邮件。

brief.en: Prototype a team dashboard with status cards, a member table, filters and explicit loading and empty states.
brief.zh: 制作包含状态卡、成员表、筛选、加载与空状态的团队仪表盘原型。

brief.en: Prototype a repository dashboard with star history, contributors and recent activity, clearly labeled as sample data until connected.
brief.zh: 制作仓库仪表盘，包含 Star 变化、贡献者和近期动态；接入前明确标为示例数据。

title.en: A manifesto, set like a magazine
title.zh: 像杂志一样排版的宣言

brief.en: Design a typographic manifesto poster with a strong headline, subhead and a carefully structured editorial grid.
brief.zh: 以有力标题、副标题和精细编辑网格设计文字宣言海报。

title.zh: 更从容的首次使用体验

brief.en: Prototype a three-screen onboarding journey with one decision per screen, accessible actions and a clear completion state.
brief.zh: 制作三屏引导原型，每屏一个决策，操作易访问，并有清晰完成状态。

brief.en: Develop an original orbital visual composition with repeated circular forms and generous negative space. Start with a still before planning motion.
brief.zh: 用重复圆形与留白构建原创轨道构图，先完成静帧，再规划动态。

title.zh: 三张社交卡片，一套视觉节奏

brief.en: Design three linked social cards using original scenery, concise headlines and a consistent visual rhythm.
brief.zh: 用原创景致、简短标题和一致视觉节奏设计三张关联社交卡片。

brief.en: Build a pre-launch waitlist page with an honest value proposition, accessible email form states and a privacy explanation.
brief.zh: 制作预发布候补页，包含真实价值说明、易访问的邮箱表单状态和隐私说明。

brief.en: Animate a short original manifesto with assertive editorial type and carefully paced transitions.
brief.zh: 用有力的编辑字体与节奏分明的转场呈现简短原创宣言。

brief.en: Turn four supplied product benefits into a high-contrast animated announcement, ending on one clear action.
brief.zh: 把四项产品价值转成高对比发布动画，结尾只保留一个行动入口。

brief.en: Create a minimal product-introduction animation with restrained type movement and meaningful pauses.
brief.zh: 用克制的文字运动与有意义的停顿制作产品介绍动画。

brief.en: Create a split-screen motion opener that contrasts handwritten emphasis with bold typography.
brief.zh: 用手写重点与粗体字的对比制作分屏动态开场。

title.en: A line chart tells the story

brief.en: Animate a time-series chart with supplied data, labeled axes and a sourced annotation at the turning point.
brief.zh: 用提供的数据制作时间序列动画，标注坐标轴，并为转折点说明附来源。

title.en: A decision tree you can follow

brief.en: Animate a branching decision flow with distinct yes/no labels and enough time to read each outcome.
brief.zh: 让分支决策流程逐步展开，明确是非标签，并留足结果阅读时间。

title.en: One idea across a split canvas
title.zh: 分屏画布上的一个想法

brief.en: Introduce a product on a two-tone canvas with a concise promise, supporting line and timed reveal.
brief.zh: 用双色画布、简短主张、补充说明和节奏化揭示介绍产品。

brief.en: Create an original glitch-title opening with readable text, controlled distortion and a reduced-motion alternative.
brief.zh: 制作文字可读、扭曲受控的原创故障风片头，并提供减少动态版本。

brief.en: Animate a short original message through scale, placement and timing rather than decorative footage.
brief.zh: 依靠缩放、位置和时间节奏，让简短原创文案成为动画主体。

brief.en: Create a warm cinematic title sequence with gentle light movement and a readable editorial title.
brief.zh: 用轻柔光影移动与易读编辑式标题制作温暖的电影感开场。

title.en: A flowing background with clear type

brief.en: Create a short motion hero with a fluid abstract background and a stable, legible message.
brief.zh: 用流动抽象背景与稳定清晰的文字制作短动态主视觉。

brief.en: Animate an approved original brand mark into a brief outro with restrained glow and a final hold.
brief.zh: 使用获准使用的原创品牌标记，制作光效克制且有结尾停留的片尾。

title.zh: 一张动态图表呈现两个指标

brief.en: Animate a combined bar-and-line chart with supplied data and distinct units for each series.
brief.zh: 按提供的数据制作柱线组合动画，为两组数据明确不同单位。

brief.en: Present one verified key metric with a small supporting chart, denominator, date and source.
brief.zh: 用小型支撑图表呈现一个已核实指标，注明分母、日期和来源。

title.zh: 有趣而清楚的数据节奏

brief.en: Create a playful data-led motion sequence with legible cards and explicit sample-data labels where needed.
brief.zh: 制作卡片易读的数据动态演示，示例数字需明确标注。

brief.en: Introduce a design product through warm editorial cards and an animated network of simple organic nodes.
brief.zh: 用暖色编辑卡片与简单有机节点网络介绍设计产品。

brief.en: Create a cursor-led text reveal for a concise original message, with readable timing and a static end frame.
brief.zh: 为简短原创文案制作光标引导的文字揭示，节奏易读，并保留结束静帧。

brief.en: Develop original animal mascot directions for a supplied product. Compare silhouettes and personality before choosing one; do not copy the preview characters.
brief.zh: 为提供的产品发展原创动物吉祥物方向，比较轮廓与性格后再选择，不复制示例角色。
